turns.customer: Standard suite for my dog Hank, 40 lbs. I'll drop him off Friday Jan 22 2027 around 6pm and pick him up Sunday Jan 24 at 6pm.
blocks:
For **Hank (40 lb)**, a Standard Suite for Friday, January 22 through Sunday, January 24, 2027 is **estimated at $130**: 2 billed days at $65 per day. The full-day rate applies regardless of drop-off time, so arriving around 6 p.m. doesn’t change the estimate.

Peak or seasonal pricing may apply, and rates may change. This is a planning estimate only—not a reservation or confirmation of availability.

turns.customer: Wait, am I paying for Friday even though he only arrives at 6?
blocks: Yes. Happy Tails’ published dog-boarding rate is charged by the day, and the full-day charge applies regardless of drop-off time. So Friday counts as a billed day even with a 6 p.m. arrival.
